Meridian

        Your first guess will light up the map. The warmer the colour, the closer you are.

        How to play

        A country is hidden somewhere on the globe. Name any country to start.

        Each guess lights up with a temperature based on the distance between its border and the hidden country's border.

        Far awayVery close

        Countries that touch the hidden country burn hottest at 0 km. Follow the heat until the globe turns green.

        Daily gives everyone the same country each day. Endless never stops. Misspelled names are corrected for you.

        Keys: / search, ←↑↓→ rotate, + − zoom.
